statement.text:
Suppose that a group G contains an element a of prime order such that its
centralizer CG (a) is finite and all subgroups ⟨a, ag ⟩, g ∈ G, are finite and almost all
of them are soluble. Is G locally finite? This problem is closely connected with 6.56.
The question was solved in the positive for a number of very important partial cases
by the author (Abstracts on Group Theory of the Mal’cev Int. Conf. on Algebra,
Novosibirsk, 1989, p. 145 (Russian)).                                       V. P. Shunkov
